summary: Mirus, operating since 1999, is a restaurant data-warehousing and reporting platform that integrates POS, guest-loyalty, inventory, speed-of-service, and labor-scheduling systems into a custom data warehouse with automated GL exports, alerts, and near-real-time (updated as often as every 15 minutes, depending on POS) reporting.
Mirus offers dedicated Toast POS integration/insights, giving Toast users access to their full Toast-collected dataset combined with other operational data sources in a unified client data warehouse.
